# LUTU

> A Cape Town content studio producing product and fashion content for Saudi and Gulf brands.
> Brands courier their products to Cape Town; LUTU shoots them with real models on Cape Town
> locations and delivers finished photographs and short vertical videos. The client never has to fly.

## What LUTU sells

LUTU sells a shoot and content service. It is not a clothing retailer and sells no garments.

1. **Remote shoots** — the main offer and the only service currently on sale. One or more shoot
   days in Cape Town with real models, delivering finished images and vertical video. AI is used
   to extend hero photographs into catalogue variations; every AI-assisted image is checked by a
   person, and hero images are always photographs of real models.
2. **Production and location support** — for Gulf brands and creators who want to shoot in South
   Africa themselves: crew, locations, permits, Muslim-friendly logistics, Arabic-speaking contact.
3. **A modest occasion-wear capsule** with a Cape Town artist — planned for later, not on sale.

## Headline offer

Ramadan & Eid Content Pack: one hero shoot day in Cape Town with real models, 30 finished images
(hero shots plus AI-extended catalogue images), 10 vertical videos for Snapchat, TikTok and
Instagram, delivered in about three weeks. Priced in US dollars with a 50% deposit to book.
The client couriers products to Cape Town and pays shipping both ways.
Launch rate for first-season clients; ask for a quote.

## Who it is for

Saudi and GCC modest-wear, abaya, occasion-wear, beauty, gifting and lifestyle brands —
particularly those selling on Salla, Zid, Noon, Instagram, Snapchat and TikTok.

## Why Cape Town

Dunes, ocean, mountain and garden locations within an hour of each other, with light and
landscape that feel familiar to a Gulf audience but are not what that audience has already seen.
Modest styling is handled with care: hijab or non-hijab, modesty level set by the brand, calm and
private locations. Cape Town's shoot season runs late October to March, which is exactly when
Ramadan and Eid content has to be made. Ramadan 2027 begins around 8 February 2027.

## Who runs it

- **Luca** — South African and Italian, based in Cape Town. Ten years as a working international
  fashion model across Cape Town, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Bali, Mumbai and Istanbul. Also
  founder of Booked. Runs casting, crew, locations and delivery. https://lucabold.com
- **Turki** — Saudi, based in Saudi Arabia. Handles Saudi and Gulf clients in Arabic and runs
  LUTU's social channels.
